items.title: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
items.summary: The Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act would ease complicated tax burdens for everyday use of cryptocurrencies, though Trump's industry ties spurred some pushback.

items.title: Anchorage expands institutional custody to Etherlink, tokenized uranium
